gripOrHq.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

gripOrHq.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

heapOrArchives.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Forged Activation Orders
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

heapOrArchives.title: Security Code WORM Chip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

scoreArea.title: Superserum
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Superserum, remove all Virus counters, and avoid receiving the next two Virus counters Runner gives to you.

rig.title: Shredder Uplink Protocol
rig.rulesText: A: Make a run on the Archives. If run is successful, do not access cards from the Archives; instead, treat run as a successful run on HQ.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Wilson, Weeflerunner Apprentice
rig.rulesText:
Each of your turns, you may choose to gain an action, which you may use only to make a run. You cannot spend more than [3] during that run to pay for using icebreakers or increasing your link. Use this ability only once per turn and only during your turn.
[T]: Avoid receiving a tag.
[T]: Prevent any amount of meat damage.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

scoreArea.title: Superserum
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Superserum, remove all Virus counters, and avoid receiving the next two Virus counters Runner gives to you.

ice.title: Brain Drain
ice.rulesText: *Roll a die. On a 1, do 3 brain damage.

root.title: London City Grid
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [1], in addition to the normal cost, to use each subroutine of a noisy icebreaker during runs on this fort. Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

ice.title: Entrapment
ice.rulesText: *If you pay [2], Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a data fort of your choice, instead of passing Entrapment. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort.

ice.title: Glacier
ice.rulesText: Rezzing Glacier cost 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. *End the run. *End the run. [1]: Move Glacier to the outermost position of any other data fort. Use this ability only at the start of a run. You may use this ability even if Glacier is unrezzed, in which case, you reveal it.

root.title: Badtimes
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Runner's MU is reduced by 2 until end of turn.

root.title: Satellite Monitors
root.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, you may roll a die for each run Runner made during his or her last turn. For each 1, give Runner a tag.

root.title: Strategic Planning Group
root.rulesText: Whenever you draw one or more cards, draw an extra card. Then place one of the drawn cards on the bottom of R&D. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

root.title: Satellite Monitors
root.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, you may roll a die for each run Runner made during his or her last turn. For each 1, give Runner a tag.

root.title: Shock Treatment
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Shock Treatment, trash all pieces of hardware and two programs. Ignore this effect unless Runner has four or more tags.

root.title: Corporate Shuffle
root.rulesText: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

root.title: Reclamation Project
root.rulesText: Search the archives for any number of ice cards. Show those cards to Runner, then store them in HQ. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

root.title: Self-Destruct
root.rulesText: Install Self-Destruct only in a subsidiary data fort. [T]. Trash all other cards installed in or on this data fort. Do 1 Net damage for each card successfully trashed in this way. Use this ability only when Runner accesses Self-Destruct.

root.title: Puzzle
root.rulesText: *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn. *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn.

ice.rulesText: *If you pay [2], Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a data fort of your choice, instead of passing Vortex. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort.
